description:
What is This Part?
This is the Complete Suzuki OEM Electronic Fuel Injection Gas Tank Kit.
You’ll get an EFI Gas Tank, an ‘In-Tank’ High Pressure Fuel Pump and a Sending Unit.
This is all plug and play* for the 1991-1995 Suzuki Samurai’s. (EFI Engines Only)
This is also a great kit if you’re converting your existing Samurai to Fuel Injection.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
* NOTE: Fuel Pump connectors are no longer made like the 91-95 Samurai. The new connection uses band clamps or wire clamps. If your flexible fuel line hoses going to the fuel pump are still good then simply cut the original connector off the end and slide onto fuel pump line, then secure with clamp.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – EFI Fuel Tank
Qty 1 – Sending Unit
Qty 1 – Gasket, Sending Unit
Qty 1 – In-Tank Fuel Pump
Qty 1 – Gasket, Fuel Pump
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1991 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1991 – 1995 All Models
